title: Ship damage model: hull, shields, dock repair
description: Server-authoritative damage pipeline foundation: shields absorb before hull, damage events with source, destroyed state at hull zero, and dock repair for a credit cost.
acceptanceCriteria: src/shared/physics/damage.ts exports applyDamage(entity, amount, source) returning {shieldHit, hullHit, destroyed}: shields absorb first, overflow to hull, hull below zero marks the entity destroyed
Damage events {kind:'damaged', target, source, amount, shieldHit, hullHit} and {kind:'destroyed', target, source} broadcast as combat_event to the whole shard
A destroyed ship stops integrating, ignores inputs, becomes non-targetable, and spawns a static wreck entity at its final position (wreck rendering is TASK-49, entity state here)

Repair: POST /api/ships/repair (auth, docked): cost = ceil((1 - hull/maxHull) * 10) + ceil((1 - shields/maxShields) * 5) credits, deducted via TASK-41 in one transaction, full restore; errors when not docked or credits insufficient
Unit tests: shield-first ordering including exact boundary cases, double-destroy guard, destroyed ships ignore inputs, repair cost table, repair transaction rollback

steps.details: Pure applyDamage operating on the entity copy the sim owns; emit result, no side effects. Source is {kind:'player'|'ai', id} for HUD attribution.

SimLoop calls applyDamage when a weapon hit lands (hook now, real weapons in TASK-43); destroyed entities skipped in integration; wreck entity inserted with kind 'wreck' and a ttl (removed after 600 s).
ships route: docked check, cost calc from class maxes, withdrawCredits in same transaction as hull/shield reset; broadcast entity_update if in-shard.
All listed unit tests + repair API tests. Run lint, typecheck, full suite.

technicalNotes: applyDamage is shared (client can pre-render shield flash from its own prediction of hits it fired), but the server result is authoritative.
Wreck ttl 600 s keeps entity counts bounded; no persistent wreck registry in v1.
